name: JoAi: Set Loyalty Collect Points

description.en: Replace the collect points of the team's loyalty program (QR codes, Advent doors, checkpoints where customers collect points themselves). Entries are matched by key: existing keys keep their id and history, keys left out are removed. Requires team manage permission.
description.de: Ersetzt die Sammelpunkte des Treueprogramms (QR-Codes, Advent-Türchen, Checkpoints, an denen Kunden selbst Punkte sammeln). Einträge werden per Key zugeordnet: bestehende Keys behalten ID und Verlauf, weggelassene Keys werden entfernt. Benötigt Team-Verwaltungsrechte.

bot: Load the program first and send the FULL list (it replaces all collect points). Each entry: key, name, source, points, optional limit (once | daily | per_window), windowMinutes (required for per_window), startsAt, endsAt, active, code, codeRotation (none | daily), meta. Omit code to keep the existing one, pass null to remove it. codeRotation daily makes the code change every midnight in the team timezone (no fixed code allowed then); omit codeRotation to keep the current mode. Today's daily code is never returned to agents; only signed-in team members see it (loyalty editor, checkpoint display). Never echo fixed codes back to customers in public channels.

inputs.name: Settings

description.en: Program settings with the full collect point list: {"collect_points": [...]}

inputs.bot: JSON object {"collect_points":[{"key":"advent-2026-7","name":"Türchen 7","source":"advent-door","points":1,"limit":"once","startsAt":"2026-12-07T00:00:00+01:00","code":"tuer-7-x9"},{"key":"checkpoint-hauptplatz","name":"Hauptplatz","source":"checkpoint","points":1,"limit":"daily","codeRotation":"daily"}]}. The list replaces all collect points.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
